title: quota_dashboard.py's rotation tick (subprocess.run on 'flock -n rotate.lock … --tick', timeout QUOTA_DASH_TICK_TIMEOUT_S 180 s, :2289-2293) kills only flock on a timeout: the Python tick it forked keeps the inherited lock and runs on as an orphan, so cron's flock -n skips silently; on 2026-10-22 offline ticks ran ~7.5 min and the board re-invoked every ~2 min (W-010bb0d9 measure). Kill the whole group (start_new_session + os.killpg) or let the tick's own watchdog (W-010bb0d9) be the bound and drop the board's timeout below it
